removed: \nWhat the procedures that make the library calls write belongs to the «Data» of chapters 3.2–3.4.
\nWhat is visible of it from outside is the heartbeat, the slot, the rival's mark, `/servers` of the console (P/06, chapter 6.5).
\nThe lesson has no HTTP contracts of its own.

\nThe forms of the read/write answers are [P/01.1](../../01-store/spec/01-store.api.openapi.yaml), of units — [P/06](../../06-console/spec/06-console.api.openapi.yaml) (chapter 6.1), of objects — [P/05](../../05-resource/spec/05-resource.norms.md#n2-doors).
\nThe heartbeat is the form of [chapter 3.4](03.4-worker.norms.md) N1.1, not an HTTP answer of the worker.
\nA subsystem that needs `stalled(id)` asks the library from its calls and keeps no failure count of its own: that count would diverge from the backoff.

\nFor every `stop_unit` other than a restart of the same unit on a growth of `revision` (P/03.1-R007), `restarting(id)` is false. Removal, a move and a worker stop are examples of this complement, not its closed list.
